checks: All three source/patch hashes match the candidate manifest.
Removing only the five declared additions (sysfs include, device pointer field, show/attribute block, pointer assignment, dev_groups registration) restores the exact baseline text.
CPU snapshot API and header ABI are unchanged. Existing PMIC write functions, call sites, bus initialization and GPU rail preparation are unchanged.
Read callback acquires cpu_supply_owner_lock before the existing p->lock; checks p and p->dev; all five PMIC reads occur under both locks. No private owner access or second TWI engine is introduced.
Callback uses only local raw-byte values after releasing locks; it does not dereference p after releasing the owner lock.
The only new PMIC transactions are fixed reads of 0x0e,0x10,0x13,0x1b,0x1d when the attribute is explicitly read. The patch adds no probe-time PMIC read or rail write.
DEVICE_ATTR_RO defines mode 0444 and no store callback.

Owner absence/wrong device and ID mismatch return errors. Failed transactions stop subsequent reads. Disabled DCDC2, reserved selector and DCDC2/3 polyphase return ERANGE with rate-limited raw-register diagnostics.
Voltage calculation, DVM bit and remote-feedback polarity match the reviewed AXP8191 sources. Output explicitly labels programmed-setpoint, not ADC voltage.

lifecycle_source.removal: 623-631 removes dev_groups before the remove callback; 608-610 releases devres during unbind cleanup.
lifecycle_source.probe_failure_cleanup: 775-785 removes device/groups and releases devres on group-creation failure.
lifecycle_source.owner_lifetime: Existing devm cpu_supply_unpublish action was registered after owner resources and runs before their release; owner lock serializes this action with reads.

pmic_decoding.polyphase: 0x1b bit6 joins DCDC2/3; reject independent DCDC2 interpretation

limits: No build, test-module loading, board reading, reboot or rail operation performed by this reviewer.
This records current programmed setpoint only; it does not independently measure physical rail voltage or establish VE frequency stability.
Reads are sequential under a software lock, not simultaneous analog samples.

author_validation_reference.reported_result: 267 extracted-callback cases passed with ASan/UBSan, including all 256 selector/DVM raw values, locking, owner and failure paths
